verses.original: δὲ Συνίστημι ὑμῖν ἡμῶν τὴν ἀδελφὴν Φοίβην οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν τῆς Κενχρεαῖς
verses.transliteration: de Synistēmi hymin hēmōn tēn adelphēn Phoibēn ousan kai diakonon tēs ekklēsias en tēs Kenchreais
verses.literal: - I commend to you our - sister Phoebe - - a servant of the church in - Cenchrea

verses.original: ἵνα προσδέξησθε αὐτὴν ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν πράγματι χρῄζῃ ὑμῶν γὰρ αὐτὴ καὶ ἐγενήθη προστάτις πολλῶν καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina prosdexēsthe autēn en Kyriō axiōs tōn hagiōn kai parastēte autē en hō an pragmati chrēzē hymōn gar autē kai egenēthē prostatis pollōn kai emou autou
verses.literal: - Welcome her in [the] Lord in a manner worthy - of [the] saints and assist her with anything . . . . . . she may need from you For she - has been a great help to many [people] including me . . .

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν μου τοὺς συνεργούς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Priskan kai Akylan mou tous synergous en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Greet Prisca and Aquila my - fellow workers in Christ Jesus

verses.original: οἵτινες ὑπέθηκαν ἑαυτῶν τὸν τράχηλον ὑπὲρ μου τῆς ψυχῆς οἷς οὐκ μόνος ἐγὼ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐχαριστῶ
verses.transliteration: hoitines hypethēkan heautōn ton trachēlon hyper mou tēs psychēs hois ouk monos egō alla kai pasai hai ekklēsiai tōn ethnōn eucharistō
verses.literal: who have risked their - [lives] for me . . . . . . - Not only I but - all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful [to them]

verses.original: καὶ τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατ’ αὐτῶν οἶκον Ἀσπάσασθε μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν Ἐπαίνετον ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ εἰς Χριστόν τῆς Ἀσίας
verses.transliteration: kai tēn ekklēsian kat’ autōn oikon Aspasasthe mou ton agapēton Epaineton hos estin aparchē eis Christon tēs Asias
verses.literal: [Greet also] the church [that meets] at their house Greet my - beloved Epenetus who was the first [convert] to Christ - in [the province of] Asia

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάν ἥτις ἐκοπίασεν πολλὰ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Marian hētis ekopiasen polla eis hymas
verses.literal: Greet Mary who has worked very hard for you

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν μου τοὺς συγγενεῖς καὶ μου συναιχμαλώτους οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις καὶ οἳ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ πρὸ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Andronikon kai Iounian mou tous syngeneis kai mou synaichmalōtous hoitines eisin episēmoi en tois apostolois kai hoi gegonan en Christō pro emou
verses.literal: Greet Andronicus and Junia my - fellow countrymen and - fellow prisoners [They] are outstanding among the apostles and [they] were in Christ before I [was]

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Ampliaton mou ton agapēton en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Ampliatus my - beloved in [the] Lord

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν ἡμῶν τὸν συνεργὸν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν Στάχυν
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Ourbanon hēmōn ton synergon en Christō kai mou ton agapēton Stachyn
verses.literal: Greet Urbanus our - fellow worker in Christ and my - beloved Stachys

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Apellēn ton dokimon en Christō Aspasasthe tous ek tōn Aristoboulou
verses.literal: Greet Apelles who [is] approved in Christ Greet those who belong to the [household] of Aristobulus

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα μου τὸν συγγενῆ Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Hērōdiōna mou ton syngenē Aspasasthe tous ek tōn Narkissou tous ontas en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Herodion my - fellow countryman Greet those from the [household] of Narcissus who are in [the] Lord

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἀσπάσασθε τὴν ἀγαπητήν Περσίδα ἥτις ἐκοπίασεν πολλὰ ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Tryphainan kai Tryphōsan tas kopiōsas en Kyriō Aspasasthe tēn agapētēn Persida hētis ekopiasen polla en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa [ women ] who have worked hard in [the] Lord Greet [my] beloved Persis who has worked very hard in [the] Lord

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν μητέρα ἐμοῦ καὶ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Rhouphon ton eklekton en Kyriō kai autou tēn mētera emou kai
verses.literal: Greet Rufus - chosen in [the] Lord and his - mother [who has been a mother] to me as well

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύνκριτον Φλέγοντα Ἑρμῆν Πατρόβαν Ἑρμᾶν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σὺν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Asynkriton Phlegonta Hermēn Patroban Herman kai tous adelphous syn autois
verses.literal: Greet Asyncritus Phlegon Hermes Patrobas Hermas and the brothers with them

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν Νηρέα καὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν ἀδελφὴν καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους σὺν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Philologon kai Ioulian Nērea kai autou tēn adelphēn kai Olympan kai pantas tous hagious syn autois
verses.literal: Greet Philologus and Julia Nereus and his - sister and Olympas and all the saints with them

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe allēlous en hagiō philēmati pasai hai ekklēsiai tou Christou Aspazontai hymas
verses.literal: Greet one another with a holy kiss All the churches - of Christ send you greetings . . .

verses.original: δὲ Παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί σκοπεῖν τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de Parakalō hymas adelphoi skopein tous poiountas tas dichostasias kai ta skandala para tēn didachēn hēn hymeis emathete kai ekklinete ap’ autōn
verses.literal: Now I urge you brothers to watch out for those who create - divisions and - obstacles [that are] contrary to the teaching - you have learned - Turn away from them

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ τοιοῦτοι οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ Χριστῷ ἀλλὰ ἑαυτῶν τῇ κοιλίᾳ καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσιν τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων
verses.transliteration: gar hoi toioutoi ou douleuousin hēmōn tō Kyriō Christō alla heautōn tē koilia kai dia tēs chrēstologias kai eulogias exapatōsin tas kardias tōn akakōn
verses.literal: For - such people {are} not serving our - Lord Christ but their [own] appetites - By - smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive

verses.original: γὰρ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο Ἡ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ οὖν χαίρω ἐφ’ ὑμῖν δὲ θέλω ὑμᾶς εἶναι σοφοὺς εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν δὲ ἀκεραίους εἰς τὸ κακόν
verses.transliteration: gar eis pantas aphiketo Hē hymōn hypakoē oun chairō eph’ hymin de thelō hymas einai sophous eis to agathon de akeraious eis to kakon
verses.literal: - vvv Everyone [has heard] - about your obedience so I rejoice over you But I want you to be wise about what [is] good and innocent about what [is] evil

verses.original: Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης δὲ ἐν τάχει συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας Ἡ χάρις ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho Theos tēs eirēnēs de en tachei syntripsei ton Satanan hypo hymōn tous podas HĒ charis hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The God - of peace vvv vvv vvv will soon crush - Satan under your - feet The grace of our - Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you

verses.original: Τιμόθεος μου ὁ συνεργός Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος μου οἱ συγγενεῖς
verses.transliteration: Timotheos mou ho synergos Aspazetai hymas kai Loukios kai Iasōn kai Sōsipatros mou hoi syngeneis
verses.literal: Timothy my - fellow worker sends you greetings . . . as do Lucius - Jason and Sosipater my - fellow countrymen

verses.original: ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν Ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: egō Tertios ho grapsas tēn epistolēn Aspazomai hymas en Kyriō
verses.literal: I Tertius who wrote down this letter greet you in [the] Lord

verses.original: Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ τῆς πόλεως οἰκονόμος Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς καὶ ὁ ἀδελφός Κούαρτος
verses.transliteration: Gaios ho xenos mou kai holēs tēs ekklēsias Aspazetai hymas Erastos ho tēs poleōs oikonomos Aspazetai hymas kai ho adelphos Kouartos
verses.literal: Gaius who has hosted me and all the church sends you greetings . . . Erastus the - city treasurer sends you greetings . . . [as does] [our] brother Quartus

verses.original: δὲ Τῷ δυναμένῳ στηρίξαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὸ μου εὐαγγέλιόν καὶ τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν μυστηρίου σεσιγημένου χρόνοις αἰωνίοις
verses.transliteration: de Tō dynamenō stērixai hymas kata to mou euangelion kai to kērygma Iēsou Christou kata apokalypsin mystēriou sesigēmenou chronois aiōniois
verses.literal: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by - my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ according to [the] revelation of [the] mystery concealed vvv for ages past

verses.original: δὲ νῦν φανερωθέντος γνωρισθέντος διά τε γραφῶν προφητικῶν κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ αἰωνίου Θεοῦ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως
verses.transliteration: de nyn phanerōthentos gnōristhentos dia te graphōn prophētikōn kat’ epitagēn tou aiōniou Theou eis panta ta ethnē eis hypakoēn pisteōs
verses.literal: but now revealed [and] made known vvv through the writings of the prophets by [the] command of the eternal God in order to lead all - nations to the obedience [that comes from] faith

verses.original: μόνῳ σοφῷ Θεῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ᾧ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: monō sophō Theō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn hō dia Iēsou Christou amēn
verses.literal: [to the] only wise God [be] glory vvv vvv forever . . . . . . - through Jesus Christ Amen
